project_type: React SPA with TypeScript and Vite
build_system: Vite 4 with tsc for type checking
build_command: NODE_OPTIONS='' npx tsc --noEmit (cannot install deps - no node_modules)
verification_instructions: Since INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network blocks npm install, verify changes are syntactically correct by reading the code. Ensure all imports/exports are consistent and no references to removed/renamed symbols remain.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot npm install, cannot run tsc or vitest against the project (no node_modules). Global tsc available but missing React/library types. All verification must be done via AST-level code review and grep-based consistency checks.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Standard React/TS conventions.
key_patterns: Functional components with Props interfaces. State managed in App.tsx with useState/useEffect. localStorage persistence via storage.ts. Tests use vi.fn() mocks and @testing-library/react render/screen/userEvent patterns.
directory_structure: src/ - main source; src/components/ - React components; src/test/ - test files mirroring component names; root has config (vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, package.json)
